title: Poignant
summary: POIGNANT, adjective poin'ant. [Latin pungere, pungo, to prick.] 1. Sharp; stimulating the organs of taste; as poignant sauce. 2. Pointed; keen; bitter; irritating; satirical; as poignant wit. 3. Sever

inlines.v: POIGNANT, adjective poin'ant. [Latin pungere, pungo, to prick.] 1. Sharp; stimulating the organs of taste; as poignant sauce. 2. Pointed; keen; bitter; irritating; satirical; as poignant wit. 3. Severe; piercing; very painful or acute; as poignant pain or grief.
